# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and Linux support**

## Highlights

The unreleased 4.159 line adds experimental image comparison APIs in a separate SkiaSharp.Testing package.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move away from Linux x86 native assets** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. To use the experimental assembly, suppress diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Comparison results retain no native handles; callers own returned difference images. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))
